items.title: Virginia Mayhew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2022
items.q: they decided that I did such a good job quote unquote that they left me on the recording, and that was when Al started hiring me.

ctx.x: And those were the days when it was hard to get to black belt. I mean not that it’s not hard now, but it was very physical, very hard core, more hard core than it is now on a fighting level. Yeah. So that was great, and he was such a nice guy, and obviously a great musician. I was so lucky, I met so many great people there and got to play with them. And then Norman introduced me to Al, he put me on a recording session of I don’t know if it was Al or somebody else, and they just brought me in to just play the…
What changed in the New York scene from the time you arrived like and the next fifteen or twenty years?
